body.text: Welcome to Fishtopia! This is a quick guide to help you get started with this fun and engaging game that exists completely on Slack.

pages.title: Introduction to Fishtopia
pages.body: Welcome to Fishtopia! This is a quick guide to help you get started with this fun and engaging game that exists completely on Slack.

pages.title: Getting Started - Equipment
pages.body: Before you can start fishing, you'll need some basic equipment such as a fishing rod and some bait. You can purchase these items from the in-game store, with better options available as you progress.

pages.title: Getting Started - Boats
pages.body: Boats allow you to travel to different areas and catch more fish. Better boats will allow you to travel further, hold more items, and catch better fish.

pages.title: Fishing - Maps
pages.body: There a variety of different maps available in Fishtopia, each with their own unique fish and availability.

pages.title: Fishing - Fish
pages.body: Fishtopia has a huge variety of fish to catch, each with their own characteristics, behaviors, and special variants. You'll be able to sell them for in-game currency.

pages.title: Market and Shop
pages.body: The market is where you can create, manage, or accept trades with other players. The shop is where you can purchase new items and equipment.

pages.title: Next Steps
pages.body: You're all set to start your fishing adventure! Happy fishing! Click the 'Finish' button to complete the guide and setup your account.
